mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) during the signal period, indicating a looming recession that will negate the positive earnings impulse.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, if not accompanied by a contemporaneous rise in unemployment, signals a supply-driven inflationary impulse that will erode real equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines > 0.5% m/m and UNRATE does not rise
failure_condition: SPX realizes positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected surge in nonfarm payrolls, exceeding the consensus estimate by > 100k jobs, signals an overheating labor market that will prompt the Fed to tighten policy and compress equity valuations over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Federal funds rate fails to rise by > 25bp in the subsequent 3 months, indicating the labor strength was not sustained and did not alter the Fed's policy trajectory.

mechanism_narrative: A collapse in consumer sentiment, as measured by the University of Michigan survey, below a threshold of 70, signals a severe demand shock that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Real personal consumption expenditures (PCE) rise by > 2% q/q in the quarter following the sentiment collapse, indicating the demand shock was not severe enough to derail the expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A flattening of the yield curve, as measured by the spread between 10-year and 2-year Treasury yields, below a threshold of 50 basis points, signals a looming recession that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve subsequently steepens by > 50bp over the next 3 months, indicating the inversion was a false signal and recession risks have abated.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in housing starts, exceeding a 6-month moving average of 1.2 million units, signals a strengthening housing sector that will boost cyclical demand and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 30-year fixed mortgage rates rise by > 100bp over the subsequent 3 months, indicating the housing strength was not sustainable and will be choked off by rising financing costs.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the ISM manufacturing PMI, above a threshold of 60, if accompanied by a contemporaneous rise in the Bloomberg Commodity Index, signals a supply-driven inflationary impulse that will erode real equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Core PCE inflation subsequently falls below 2% y/y over the next 6 months, indicating the inflationary impulse was transitory and did not alter the Fed's policy trajectory.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the effective federal funds rate, exceeding a threshold of 2.5%, signals a tightening monetary cycle that will compress equity valuations and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Federal funds rate subsequently falls by > 50bp over the next 3 months, indicating the tightening was a policy error and will be reversed, removing the valuation headwind.
